Biography
The poem "Father Son and Holy Ghost" by Audre Lorde explores themes of family, memory, and loss. In it, Lorde reflects on her father's absence and the impact of his silence on her life. The poem begins with the line, "I have not ever seen my father’s grave," and delves into the complexities of her relationship with her father and the legacy he left behind. For the full text of the poem, you can visit the Poetry Foundation or read excerpts on Best Poems and Poemist. Poetry Foundation

 In solemn power come down!
 Present with Thy heavenly host,
 Thine ordinance to crown:
 See a sinful worm of earth!
 Bless to him the cleansing flood,
 Plunge him, by a second birth,
 Into the depths of God. 
Let the promised inward grace
 Accompany the sign;
 On his new-born soul impress
 The character divine;
 Father, all Thy Name reveal!
 Jesus, all Thy Name impart!
 Holy Ghost, renew, and dwell
 For ever in his heart!
